8fa246.conditions: A rank finishes the NC P-matrix build (all its own dofs finalized) while a NeighborRowMessage it does not need (ghost-dof row, or a row forwarded in a later round by a rank whose group view differs) is still in flight, so the cleanup Iprobe/RecvDrop loop at pfespace.cpp:4570 misses it
8fa246.reasoning: ParFiniteElementSpace's NC conforming-interpolation build receives rows with MPI_Iprobe(MPI_ANY_SOURCE, tag) and stops once its own ndofs are finalized. Ranks also receive rows they do not need: ghost dofs (the code accepts dof >= ndofs), and rows forwarded by ForwardRow in a later round when group views differ. A rank can finish before such a message arrives. The cleanup loop then drops only the messages that have already arrived, and nothing collective makes sure all sends were matched. A late message stays queued under the same tag. The next build (fespace.Update after Rebalance, the next AMR iteration, or another space) picks it up with IProbe at line 4314 and decodes it against the changed mesh or space. That writes stale rows, with old global column numbers, into pmatrix or miscounts num_finalized: a wrong P (wrong solution), or a crash or abort if the decoded ids are invalid. Whether this happens depends only on message timing.
